title: optimize-nccl-overlap-commute-tensor-parallel: tune NCCL collectives and overlap comm/compute for multi-GPU
description: Summary: Improve multi-GPU tensor-parallel throughput and latency by tuning NCCL collective parameters, adding a non-blocking collective scheduler to better overlap communication and compute, and small runtime/kernels changes to reduce synchronization stalls. Motivation: production workloads show periodic p99 latency spikes and suboptimal utilization in tensor-parallel configurations when sequence lengths vary. This PR introduces conservative NCCL tuning, an async collective submission path, and a light-weight dependency tracker so KV cache warming + continuous batching can better overlap with inter-GPU collectives. Changes are kept opt-in behind a runtime flag to allow gradual rollout. Includes microbenchmarks and end-to-end perf runs showing 12-22% throughput improvement and 8-15% p99 latency reduction for large-model tensor-parallel serving workloads on 8xA100 clusters.
author: Asha Patel
commits: 3 commits: 1) tune: adjust NCCL op timeouts, buffer sizes, and algorithm hints; 2) runtime: add AsyncCollectiveScheduler and dependency tracker; 3) kernel: small sync-to-async path changes and KV-cache staging improvements for TP mode.
diff_snippets: src/runtime/tensor_parallel/collective_scheduler.cpp: added AsyncCollectiveScheduler::submitNonBlocking(WorkId, cudaStream_t) that enqueues requested collective with dependency metadata and returns immediately
src/runtime/tensor_parallel/nccl_utils.cpp: tweak NCCL_COLL_ALGO_HINT and set NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1 for better tolerance; expose env override REDWOOD_TP_NCCL_BUFFER_MB
src/runtime/kernel/kv_cache_staging.cpp: stage KV cache transfer earlier on a dedicated stream and mark ready to reduce wait time during first tokens in continuous batching
